"""Semantic-equivalence test: fancy spellings must canonicalize identically (replay, not conflict)."""
import random, json
from harness import run, hx, envelope

ACCOUNTS = [
    {'id': 'alice', 'default': 'sip:alice@lab.test',
     'aliases': ['sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:desk@lab.test', 'tel:+12025550100']},
    {'id': 'bob', 'default': 'sips:bob@lab.test',
     'aliases': ['sips:bob@lab.test', 'tel:+442071234567']},
]
PEERS = [{'id': 'edge', 'mode': 'access', 'accounts': []},
         {'id': 'r_both', 'mode': 'relay', 'accounts': ['alice', 'bob']}]
ANON = 'sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid'
HEX = '0123456789abcdefABCDEF'

def mangle_sip(rng, u):
    scheme, rest = u.split(':', 1)
    user, hostport = rest.rsplit('@', 1)
    out_user = ''.join(('%%%02X' % ord(c)) if (c.isalnum() and rng.random() < 0.4) else c for c in user)
    host = ''.join(c.upper() if (c.isalpha() and rng.random() < 0.5) else c for c in hostport)
    return rng.choice([scheme.upper(), scheme.lower()]) + ':' + out_user + '@' + host

def mangle_tel(rng, u):
    d = u[4:]
    seps = '-.()'
    out = []
    for c in d:
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            out.append(rng.choice(seps))
        out.append(c)
    return rng.choice(['tel:', 'TEL:', 'Tel:']) + ''.join(out)

def mangle(rng, u):
    if u == ANON and rng.random() < 0.5:
        return 'SIP:anonymous@ANONYMOUS.INVALID'
    return mangle_tel(rng, u) if u.startswith('tel:') else mangle_sip(rng, u)

def dn(rng):
    return rng.choice([None, '', 'Alice', 'Alice Smith', '"Alice, QA"', '"Bob \\"B\\" X"', '"A B"  ', 'Z9'])

def addr(rng, u):
    d = dn(rng)
    mu = mangle(rng, u)
    if d is None:
        return rng.choice([mu, '<%s>' % mu, ' <%s> ' % mu])
    if d == '':
        return rng.choice(['"" <%s>' % mu, '""<%s>' % mu])
    return '%s <%s>' % (d, mu) if rng.random() < 0.7 else '%s<%s>' % (d, mu)

def fancy_wire(rng, s):
    lines = []
    tgt = mangle(rng, s['target'])
    lines.append('%s %s SIP/2.0' % (s['method'], tgt))
    fr = addr(rng, s['from_uri'])
    sep = rng.choice([';tag=', ' ; tag = ', '; tag=', ' ;tag = '])
    fromline = 'From: %s%s%s' % (fr, sep, s['tag'])
    toline = 'To: %s' % addr(rng, s['target'])
    ciline = 'Call-ID: %s' % s['call_id']
    csnum = ('%0*d' % (rng.randint(len(str(s['cseq'])), 10), s['cseq']))
    ws = rng.choice([' ', '  ', '\t', ' \t '])
    csline = 'CSeq: %s%s%s' % (csnum, ws, s['method'])
    clline = 'Content-Length: %0*d' % (rng.randint(len(str(len(s['body']))), 6), len(s['body']))
    hdrs = [(rng.choice(['From', 'f']), fromline.split(': ', 1)[1]),
            (rng.choice(['To', 't']), toline.split(': ', 1)[1]),
            (rng.choice(['Call-ID', 'i']), ciline.split(': ', 1)[1]),
            ('CSeq', csline.split(': ', 1)[1]),
            ]
    if s['pai']:
        items = ', '.join(addr(rng, u) for u in s['pai'])
        hdrs.append(('P-Asserted-Identity', items))
    if s['ppi']:
        items = ', '.join(addr(rng, u) for u in s['ppi'])
        hdrs.append(('P-Preferred-Identity', items))
    if s['privacy'] != 'absent':
        hdrs.append(('Privacy', rng.choice([s['privacy'], s['privacy'].upper(), ' ' + s['privacy'] + ' '])))
    hdrs.append((rng.choice(['Content-Length', 'l']), clline.split(': ', 1)[1]))
    hdrs.append(('X-Ignored', 'anything at all, even "quotes" <and brackets>'))
    rng.shuffle(hdrs) if rng.random() < 0.3 else None
    for name, value in hdrs:
        line = '%s: %s' % (name, value)
        if rng.random() < 0.3 and len(line) > 12:
            cut = rng.randrange(4, len(line) - 2)
            line = line[:cut].rstrip(' \t') + '\r\n ' + line[cut:].lstrip(' \t')
        lines.append(line)
    return ('\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n\r\n').encode() + s['body']

def plain_wire(s):
    lines = ['%s %s SIP/2.0' % (s['method'], s['target']),
             'From: <%s>;tag=%s' % (s['from_uri'], s['tag']),
             'To: <%s>' % s['target'],
             'Call-ID: %s' % s['call_id'],
             'CSeq: %d %s' % (s['cseq'], s['method'])]
    if s['pai']:
        lines.append('P-Asserted-Identity: ' + ', '.join('<%s>' % u for u in s['pai']))
    if s['ppi']:
        lines.append('P-Preferred-Identity: ' + ', '.join('<%s>' % u for u in s['ppi']))
    if s['privacy'] != 'absent':
        lines.append('Privacy: %s' % s['privacy'])
    lines.append('Content-Length: %d' % len(s['body']))
    return ('\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n\r\n').encode() + s['body']

rng = random.Random(4242)
pool = ['sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:desk@lab.test', 'tel:+12025550100', 'sips:bob@lab.test', 'tel:+442071234567']
fails = 0
for trial in range(400):
    peer = rng.choice(['edge', 'r_both'])
    auth = None if peer == 'r_both' else rng.choice(['alice', 'bob'])
    s = dict(peer=peer, auth=auth, egress=rng.choice(['internal', 'external']),
             privacy=rng.choice(['absent', 'id', 'none']),
             pai=rng.sample(pool, rng.choice([0, 1, 2])) or None,
             ppi=rng.sample(pool, rng.choice([0, 1, 2])) or None,
             from_uri=rng.choice(pool + [ANON]),
             tag=rng.choice(['t1', 'T2', "a'b~c"]), call_id=rng.choice(['c1', 'c-2@x']),
             cseq=rng.choice([1, 42, 2147483647]), method=rng.choice(['MESSAGE', 'INVITE']),
             body=rng.choice([b'', b'x', b'\x00\r\n\xff binary']),
             target=rng.choice(['sip:bob@lab.test', 'sips:bob@lab.test']))
    # a 2-item PAI/PPI must be one sip/sips + one tel
    for k in ('pai', 'ppi'):
        if s[k] and len(s[k]) == 2:
            kinds = [u.startswith('tel:') for u in s[k]]
            if kinds[0] == kinds[1]:
                s[k] = [s[k][0], rng.choice([u for u in pool if u.startswith('tel:') != kinds[0]])]
    plain = plain_wire(s)
    fancy = fancy_wire(rng, s)
    doc = envelope([{'t': 0, 'peer': peer, 'auth': auth, 'egress': s['egress'], 'wire_hex': hx(plain)},
                    {'t': 1, 'peer': peer, 'auth': auth, 'egress': s['egress'], 'wire_hex': hx(fancy)}],
                   accounts=ACCOUNTS, peers=PEERS, ttl=1000, cap=10)
    out = run(doc)
    r0, r1 = out['results']
    if r0['decision'] == 'reject':
        if r1['decision'] != 'reject' or r1['reason'] != r0['reason']:
            fails += 1; print('MISMATCH reject', trial, r0, r1, '\n', fancy)
        continue
    if r1['decision'] != 'replay' or r1.get('first') != 0:
        fails += 1
        print('MISMATCH replay', trial, json.dumps(r0, sort_keys=True), json.dumps(r1, sort_keys=True))
        print(fancy.decode('latin-1'))
        if fails > 3: break
        continue
    a = {k: v for k, v in r0.items() if k not in ('index', 'decision', 'first')}
    b = {k: v for k, v in r1.items() if k not in ('index', 'decision', 'first')}
    if a != b:
        fails += 1; print('MISMATCH fields', trial, a, b, '\n', fancy.decode('latin-1'))
print('spelling trials done, fails:', fails)
PYEOF
